about: Product tags for compiled Google rules (#57), read by the compiler's product pass. 'names' are what the source calls each product (regex). A rule gets Product.<tag> when its text is scoped to the product ('In Android documentation, ...', 'For Google Cloud ...'), when it sits under a section named for it (pages other than the Word-List), when its fix writes the product name into text that didn't have it, when its Word-List entry's definition starts 'In/For <product> ...', when its entry is listed under 'entries' (Google product vocabulary the source doesn't mark), or when its id is listed under 'rules'. Tags are only ever added. A guide that defines no Product condition tags skips every tagged rule, lint rows included.
